verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents a self-serve path: a forever-free plan for 3 users, free spreadsheet import, and Zia building modules, reports and workflows in seconds. Together these suggest a founder could load real data and set up without a partner. Nothing shows the under-an-hour timeline, a guided onboarding flow, or ready-made deal pipeline setup, so delivery depth is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of a guided onboarding or setup wizard, documented default pipeline/stage configuration, import mapping and dedupe details, hands-on or independent reports of time-to-value under an hour without a partner.
